coreMemory.english: n. to go from one place to another；v. to go from one place to another
coreMemory.structure: travel abroad /ˈtrævəl əbrɔd/（出国旅行）；travel by train /ˈtrævəl baɪ treɪn/（乘火车旅行）；travel around /ˈtrævəl ɚaʊnd/（到处旅行）；business travel /bɪznəs ˈtrævəl/（商务旅行）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use travel with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of travel in context；❌ translate travel word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “travel abroad”

commonErrors.wrong: use travel with the same article in every context

commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv ˈtrævəl ɪn kɑntɛkst/
